title: Survey data on perceived farm resilience, risk management, risk preferences, and risk perceptions from 11 European countries
descriptions: This dataset contains data on the perceived resilience, risk management, risk preferences, and risk perceptions of farmers from 11 different European countries. It contains cleaned survey data from 996 farmers.
